about_short_description.short_description: Rownd is a B2B SaaS frictionless authentication company.

product.name: Passwordless Sign-In
product.description: Provides secure, frictionless user authentication using passkeys and magic links without requiring passwords.

product.name: Pre-built UI Components
product.description: Offers ready-to-use interface elements for authentication, payments, and user flows to accelerate app development.

product.name: Customizable User Flows
product.description: Enables tailoring of sign-in, subscription, and user management flows to align with specific branding and user experience needs.

product.name: SDKs and APIs for Integration
product.description: Provides software development kits and APIs to integrate authentication, payments, and deep linking quickly into apps.

product.name: Subscription and Payment Management (Rownd Payments)
product.description: Facilitates in-app subscription setup and management with Stripe integration, handling billing and access control without backend coding.

product.name: Smart Links and Deep Linking
product.description: Delivers smart deep links that direct users to specific app locations across devices, enhancing navigation and marketing campaigns.
